packageRules.description: Only track Pele for now. Remove this rule to let Renovate manage the rest of the workspace.
One PR per Pele release, including a changeset so the packages are release-ready.
prBodyNotes: This PR tracks the latest [Pele](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pele) release. Renovate adds a patch changeset for `mdast-pele`, `astro-pele` and `starlight-pele`, so merging this PR makes the update ready for the changesets release flow.
